brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Built two adjacent full hex cells (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full) each fitted with hex-bin-full (bin:0,0,0 and bin:1,0,0) providing two deep trays for utensils; dressed with fork/knife/spoon props to show use.

Configurator checks fit/collisions only; cannot verify waterproofing. Parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material. Drained vs solid bin geometry does not guarantee sealing - solid bins provided but layer lines/joints not certified waterproof.
Configurator checks fit only; knows nothing about heat resistance, food/dishwasher safety. Parts are 3D-printed plastic dependent on user-chosen filament; no dishwasher safety can be claimed.

finish.summary: Built compact 2-cell holder with two full-depth bins, capped and locked; staged with utensils. Waterproof and dishwasher-safe cannot be met by configurator - requires material choice and certification outside build verification.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
